interview.secured: I think it means I posted my proof for today's tasks and the day counts toward my streak, but the profile shows '1 days secured, 0 verified', so I'm not sure a secured day is checked by anyone.
interview.freeze: The app never explained what a freeze is, and I didn't see the word on any screen I went through.
interview.selfReported: I'm guessing it means I just tap that I did the task and nobody checks it, but the app didn't spell that out anywhere I saw.
interview.tomorrow: 6 - the hydration check is easy to do on a break at 3 am, but I'm too tired to figure out what verified versus secured means.

goals.text: Finish onboarding and one task with as few decisions as possible, until the app says the day is secured.

device: GRIIT iPhone 16. Persona phone size was recorded and not applied, because this is the simulator that has the app installed.
